Direction: Read the given information carefully and answer the question that follows

Five children P, Q, R, S, and T are from different states U.P, M.P, Bihar, Rajasthan and Punjab but not necessarily in the same order. Each one likes only one fruit out of Apple, Mango, Pomegranate, Grapes, and Strawberry. R is from Punjab and he does not like Apple or Grapes. P likes Mango and he is not from M.P or Bihar. T likes Pomegranate and he is from Rajasthan.

The person who likes strawberry is from which state?
